resources.string: Device Admin is active. The app cannot be uninstalled until you deactivate Device Admin in Settings > Security > Device Administrators.
Activating Device Admin prevents PBLOCK from being uninstalled. This protects the content blocking settings from being bypassed by removing the app.

To remove PBLOCK:
1. Open Settings
2. Go to Security > Device Administrators
3. Deactivate PBLOCK
4. Uninstall the app
Protection is ACTIVE and cannot be bypassed. Solve all puzzles to disable.
Protection persists across reboots. Blocking will be re-applied automatically.
